name: W. Zeng
evidence: FULL NAME RESOLVED, and the parent hypothesis was wrong: this is NOT 'Wei-Dong Zeng' at BLCU. Semantic Scholar author 2014850290 ('W. Zeng', the exact author id on doi 10.3390/bdcc10090290) publishes metaphor / corpus-discourse work with Kathleen Ahrens, Chu-Ren Huang and Dennis Tay at Hong Kong PolyU ('Tracing Social Change through Metaphor' 2023; 'Corpus-Based Metaphorical Framing Analysis: WAR Metaphors in Hong Kong Public Discourse' 2023; 'Metaphor and gender' 2024 with Ahrens, Burgers and Chu-Ren Huang; 'Modeling legitimation in discourse' 2026 with Jie-Yu Chen, Chu-Ren Huang, Ahrens). S2 author search for 'Winnie Zeng' returns this same author id, and the adjacent record 41132872 'Hui-Heng Zeng' carries the same research line and co-authors (K. Ahrens, D. Tay: 'Conceptualizing EDUCATION in Hong Kong and China' 2017, 'Using a Corpus of English and Chinese Political Speeches for Metaphor Analysis' LREC 2018). So W. Zeng = Winnie Huiheng Zeng. ResearchGate CONFIRMED by snippet anchor: 'Winnie ZENG | Research Assistant Professor | PhD | The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Hong Kong | PolyU | Research profile', interests corpus linguistics / metaphor / framing - matches org (PolyU), topic and shared co-author Chu-Ren Huang. LinkedIn: searched site:linkedin.com/in 'Huiheng Zeng' + linguistics/metaphor/Hong Kong - no match; only unrelated Zeng namesakes (Huan Zeng, Hong Zeng, Xinyi Zeng), all rejected. Email: MDPI page and the PolyU IRA repository PDF (ira.lib.polyu.edu.hk) and aclanthology.org are all blocked by this environment's egress proxy; no arXiv record. No templated address guessed. | Semantic Scholar checked (paper 22d48975..., DOI 10.3390/bdcc10090290): author list confirmed, but S2 Graph API exposes no email field and returned empty affiliations/homepage for all five authors; openAccessPdf resolves to doi.org, and doi.org/mdpi.com are blocked by the environment's network policy, so the MDPI affiliation block (which would print the addresses) is unreachable from this session.
